scope: Supabase project knkuxdfnfokqxbgnxzpe, read-only metadata only; no patient rows

indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dose_events_pkey ON public.dose_events USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dose_events_one_missed_idx ON public.dose_events USING btree (dose_occurrence_id) WHERE (type = 'missed'::dose_event_type)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dose_events_client_event_profile_idx ON public.dose_events USING btree (patient_profile_id, client_event_id) WHERE (client_event_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dose_occurrences_pkey ON public.dose_occurrences USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dose_occurrences_unique_idx ON public.dose_occurrences USING btree (schedule_id, scheduled_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dose_occurrences_client_event_idx ON public.dose_occurrences USING btree (patient_profile_id, client_event_id) WHERE (client_event_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX stock_transactions_pkey ON public.stock_transactions USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX stock_tx_med_idx ON public.stock_transactions USING btree (medication_id, created_at DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX stock_tx_dose_event_idx ON public.stock_transactions USING btree (dose_event_id) WHERE (dose_event_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX stock_tx_dose_occurrence_idx ON public.stock_transactions USING btree (dose_occurrence_id, created_at DESC) WHERE (dose_occurrence_id IS NOT NULL)
